# Trendy Packaging Ghana Limited (TPGL)

> Plastic packaging manufacturer in Spintex, Accra, Ghana, founded in 2017. Makes plastic bottles, jars, measuring cups and custom moulds in PE, PP, LDPE and PET for pharmaceutical, cosmetic and home care brands.

## Key facts

- Legal name: Trendy Packaging Ghana Limited (short name: TPGL)
- Address: No. 18 Martey Carpenter Road, Spintex, Accra, Ghana
- Phone / WhatsApp: +233 26 957 9956
- Email: trendypackaginglimited@gmail.com
- Founded: 2017
- Materials: PE, PP, LDPE, PET (food-grade; compliant with Ghanaian safety and environmental regulations)
- Minimum order: 5,000 units. Maximum order: 25,000 units.
- Lead time: 1–2 weeks depending on quantity
- Custom moulds: yes, made exclusively for the client's brand
- Labelling: yes. Printing: no.
- Delivery: no. Orders are packed in PE sacks for pickup at the Spintex factory.
